annotation:
替换占位几何体的俯视角精灵集

Purpose: placeholder-quality 2D-flavored top-down sprite set for "Candle Prototype Arena" (NIGHT-001), to replace primitive capsules/cubes later.
Needed: player scavenger (top-down, 64x64), runner/drone/brute enemies (64x64 each, 2-frame idle + 2-frame wind-up), barricade plug (96x48, intact + broken), ground tile (128x128, dark, subtle noise), wall segment (128x64).
Style: flat, readable silhouettes, muted palette (dark slate ground, cyan player, orange/purple/red enemies); outline 2 px.
Format: PNG with transparency, 1x scale (no packing required), no anti-aliased halo on outlines.
Constraints: no photorealism, no text baked in; consistent 45-degree top-down perspective.
prototype_only: placeholder until reviewed.
